title: Discover
summary: Dana's Discover right after she added DJDL: DJDL's access rule for verified example.edu emails gave her Education through the same issuance as signing in, with no key, so the tile shows In your library with its download as the next step, and a toast says to sign in. Diceroll, shown to everyone signed in with Free for every account, still offers Add to library above its store links. The tiles are the Library's dense ones (PX-35); two products sit centred, at most 768 px wide. Same shell as the Library, without its 'Missing a license?' strip.
compare: 2026-10-20 redraw (PX-35, BR-lockups), to the owner-approved build: the header's Activate license button is gone (the account menu's first item, 'Activate a license'); the phone bar is Library · Discover, docked full width; the 'Polaris Locker · Help · Privacy' footer is gone (Help and Privacy are in the account menu); the header brand is the trimmed outlined Locker lockup at the guide's size (BR-lockups: 40 px tall in the 64 px header, 36 px under 761 px, the mark alone under 384 px); the tiles are the Library's dense ones (5:2 art, 40 px icon, 12 px padding, one line of facts, so DJDL's 'Then keeps the last version' moves to its license page), with 'In your library' on the art's top-right corner; one or two products sit centred, at most 768 px wide (one column under 400 px), three or more take the Library's 2/3/4/5 columns. Decision: Discover has no 'Missing a license?' strip; it is the Library's (the build renders it on the Library route only).

Header counts: Library 1, Discover 1 as a count (products still to add); on phone a dot on the docked bar's Discover tab (labelled 'Discover, 1 to add'), no other nagging. The bar is Library · Discover.

Grid (kit .portal-grid.dense.pair for one or two products): centred, at most 768 px wide, two columns from 400 px, one under it (390 phone); three or more products use the Library's dense columns (three from 761 px, four from 1180 px, five from 1700 px). Store links and the reason line wrap inside the tile.

Each tile: the cover art in a 5:2 band from the tile's top edge, edge to edge (never a cropped band), the 40 px icon 16 over its lower edge, the name (16/22) with its developer beside it, what you get in the Library's vocabulary (tier pill, device pill, one duration line), platform glyphs (platforms only, one image named by them: Diceroll iOS as the phone glyph, Android, Windows, Linux), the reason line in a sunken callout, one action, and the store links or 'Go to DJDL' in a row under it (two lines reserved, so tiles side by side keep their actions level).

Visibility is one setting per product, storefront.polarisKey.visibility (PS-12), worded on the Access page as Hidden (unlisted), People who can get it (eligible) and Everyone signed in (everyone). Hidden never shows; People who can get it shows only when accessFor() or a store or obtain path gives this account something (DJDL); Everyone signed in shows to every account (Diceroll). A product already in the library leaves Discover, except the just-added state until the page reloads.

The reason line is always shown (owner, 2026-10-04): the fact that matched ('You have a confirmed example.edu email'), or 'For everyone with a Polaris Locker account'. The rule's label ('Education license') is not repeated beside the Education tier pill, and 'Free' is not repeated beside the Free pill (owner, 2026-10-08: each fact once).

Add to library runs the same issuance as signing in to the app (LX-38): no key is made, the license source is 'Automatic grant', and there is one license per account and product even when a sign-in races it.

Add to library states: busy 'Adding…' with a spinner and the button disabled; failure inline under the button, 'Couldn't add Diceroll. Check your connection and try again.'; a sign-in that already issued the license wins the race and the tile flips to In your library with no error; withdrawn, inline 'Example Audio no longer gives DJDL to your account.'

Just added: ink outline, an 'In your library' pill on the art's top-right corner; the action becomes the next step, Download for macOS (outlined: a covered build for this OS comes before Open while the app hasn't been seen on this device), with 'Go to DJDL' as a text link. Phone: 'Email me the download'. PORTAL.md §4.16 and §5.4's precedence need the same change.

Diceroll: Free for everyone, Add to library, duration 'Lifetime', and 'Buy Standard or packs on' Steam, App Store, Google Play, itch.io as accent links with the arrow-up-right glyph and labels like 'Buy Standard or packs on Steam (opens Steam)', quieter than Add to library. No prices: Polaris Locker checkout waits on owner decision 5.
A product shown to everyone signed in that gives this account nothing free shows its store links as the tile's action instead of Add to library (not drawn).

Empty: PORTAL.md §4.16's 'Nothing to add right now', 'When a developer makes something available to your account, like a free game, a beta or an app your team gets, it appears here.', Back to your library (not drawn).

Portal v2 (B2, B12): the docked header, the one filled primary is ink, tile actions outlined, the page h1 at the display step (48/52, 32/36 on a phone) with no full stop or eyebrow, no glow or wash, no chartreuse; text never painted over art; weights 400/500/600.
The h1 is the display step with no full stop and no eyebrow; tiles outlined; the in-library state keeps its outline (B12, overview-14).
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): Ownership and eligibility decide the action
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): Visual prominence never invents an offer
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): In-library state is encoded in form (outline) as well as words
Round 2 (UX review): The just-added tile is an ink outline (form, not colour), never a green hairline; the Discover count is neutral (m8).

Phone: one column, the toast above the docked bar, no footer; the account avatar alone in its ring. Checks: no sideways scroll from 320 to 2560 px; axe 0 violations at 390, 1024, 1440 and 1920 in both themes.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Needs fixes, now applied: Add to library now leads to the download, the toast offers it and can be dismissed, the phone bar matches the kit, store links read as links, 'offer' is gone and the missing states are specified; the 3-column grid is kept.

findings.issue: After Add to library the tile and toast offered only 'Open', with no way to get DJDL.
findings.resolution: Just-added tile: 'Download for macOS' (outlined) with 'Go to DJDL' as a text link; phone 'Email me the download'. Toast: 'Download it, then sign in with dana@example.edu. No key needed.' with Download (phone: Email me). The PORTAL.md §4.16 and §5.4 precedence change (a covered build for this OS before Open while the app hasn't been seen on this device) is noted for the lead.

findings.issue: Toast action was plain text; no dismiss; it sat over the footer.
findings.resolution: The action is the kit's accent text button, plus a 28 px close × labelled Dismiss; the toast is role=status and the compare list says it stays until dismissed while it carries an action. The phone shot now draws it at the page's end above the bar.

findings.issue: No dot on the phone Discover tab; Activate drawn as a plain tab.
findings.resolution: The Discover tab carries the kit's .dot, labelled 'Discover, 1 to add'; Activate is the kit's outlined .act pill; the screen's own unused .dot rule is gone.

findings.issue: Store links looked like neutral labels, gave no sign of leaving Polaris Locker and competed with Add to library.
findings.resolution: Accent links with an underline and the arrow-up-right glyph, labelled like 'Buy Standard or packs on Steam (opens Steam)', smaller and quieter than the outlined Add to library.

findings.issue: 'Lifetime · packs sold in the game' mixed selling into the duration; iOS drew the Apple glyph and stores were mixed into the platform row.
findings.resolution: Duration 'Lifetime'; buy row 'Buy Standard or packs on …'. Platform glyphs are platforms only: iOS as the phone glyph, Android, Windows and Linux (Diceroll's builds in the distribution screens). Applied to portal.library too.

findings.issue: Discover's avatar was solid violet; the other screens use the lavender one.
findings.resolution: 'avatar sm' (lavender), as on the other portal screens.

findings.issue: 'Offers to your account' and 'stopped this offer' used 'offer', the glossary's storefront item.
findings.resolution: End tile 'Made available to you'; lede 'Products their developers make available to your account'; the withdrawn error 'Example Audio no longer gives DJDL to your account.' (compare list). PORTAL.md §4.16 uses 'offer' throughout: noted for the lead.

findings.issue: Missing states (busy, network failure, race, empty, store-links-only tile); 3 columns versus PORTAL.md's 4.
findings.resolution: Compare lines: busy 'Adding…' with a spinner and the button disabled; failure inline 'Couldn't add Diceroll. Check your connection and try again.' with Try again; a racing sign-in flips the tile to In your library with no error; the store-links-only tile; the empty state. The end tile gained 'Some show store links'. Kept 3 columns (the Library's large tile; the reason line and store links need the width); PORTAL.md §4.16's 4-column grid is noted for the lead.

findings.issue: Card art took over half of a tablet tile and pushed the second tile below the fold on phone.
findings.resolution: Art is 16:7 capped at 140px (112px on phone); body padding 16, rows on a 24px rhythm; no 16:9 art on tiles.

findings.issue: Wide layout had 336px of dead gutter and a blank lower third.
findings.resolution: Content max-width 1520px from 1700px; tile grid auto-fit from 380px; toast anchored to the content column's right edge.

findings.issue: The 'What shows up here' panel narrated mechanism and the subtitle was wrong for an Education grant.
findings.resolution: Panel deleted; subtitle 'Free and eligible products'; one muted line under the grid: 'Purchases appear in your library automatically.'

findings.issue: Primary buttons sat at different heights, store links wrapped into orphans, and the Diceroll audience was stated three times.
findings.resolution: Actions at the tile bottom with the store links (and Go to DJDL) in a reserved row under them, so the buttons are level; the 'For everyone' box is gone; the eligibility callout stays on DJDL only.

findings.issue: 'In library' was stated four times (outline, pill, toast, nav count) and the toast button repeated the tile's.
findings.resolution: 1px green outline plus the pill; toast is 'Added to your library' with one line and no Download button; 32px close target; 12px above the phone bar; Discover count labelled for screen readers.

findings.issue: One scale step between a 40px title and 18-20px card titles.
findings.resolution: Page title 28/36, tile title 20, body 14, meta 12.

findings.issue: Move the helper strip to a 320px right rail, or use four tile columns with an end tile.
findings.resolution: declined: A rail or a fourth tile brings back the panel that is being removed. A strip under the grid holds at every width.

findings.issue: Show a numeric count on the phone Discover tab instead of the dot, and enlarge tab labels.
findings.resolution: declined: The numeric count is in the header on desktop; the phone bar is a kit component and its label size is handled in the kit.
